name: Stormbringer: Comforting Winds trades haste with the Air Elemental (#1044)
contract: #1044 Comforting Winds (704209) promises a reciprocal haste loop: the Stormbringer's damage hastes the Air Elemental and the Air Elemental's damage hastes the Stormbringer. 704209 is a SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL passive with ProcFlags = 0, so no proc entry is generated and its trigger 584235 (TARGET_UNIT_PET, SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS) never fires. The other half is carried by 584238 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID on TARGET_UNIT_PET, triggering 584237 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER), which nothing in the shipped data ever casts and which also has ProcFlags = 0. The fix keeps 584238 on the Air Elemental while the owner has 704209 and adds the two missing spell_proc rows. The expected step is 1% per stack, up to 5 stacks, for 10 seconds, taken from the effective DBC: 584235 and 584237 both have EffectBasePoints[0] = 0 with EffectDieSides[0] = 1 (SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue gives 1), StackAmount = 5 and DurationIndex 1 (SpellDuration.Duration = 10000). The issue body's '2%' and 584238's own hardcoded '1%, stacking 10 times' text are both contradicted by the effective rows and are not asserted.
